pt.headline: Nazaré oferece as melhores ondas da manhã!
pt.advice: Ondas de 1,7 m com período de 10 s e vento leve (5 kt) prometem sessões consistentes. A água está em 16,8 °C, então um fato 3/2 mm é ideal. Sem avisos costeiros na zona, o pico costuma estar menos cheio nas primeiras horas.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo; Nazaré costuma estar menos lotada antes das 10 h.

en.headline: Nazaré serves the best morning surf!
en.advice: 1.7 m waves with a 10‑second period and light wind (5 kt) give a solid session. Water is 16.8 °C, so a 3/2 mm wetsuit is recommended. No coastal warnings are active, and the spot is usually quieter early.
en.crowdTip: Get there early; Nazaré is typically less crowded before 10 am.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas e período adequado, mas há avisos de interação com animais marinhos (ANAV NR 12/24 e NR 2257/26).
spots.enReason: Good waves and period, but coastal warnings for marine animal interaction (ANAV NR 12/24 & NR 2257/26).

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes; atenção aos avisos de interação e avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1445/26 e NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Consistent waves; watch for marine animal interaction and sighting warnings (ANAV NR 1445/26 & NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Melhor combinação de onda, vento leve e sem avisos costeiros ativos.
spots.enReason: Best mix of wave size, light wind, and no active coastal warnings.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ótimas ondas e vento calmo, porém há aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Great waves and calm wind, but there is a marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de qualidade; atenção ao aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Quality waves; be aware of the marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Score baixo, vento mais forte (8 kt) e aviso de plano de salvamento marítimo (ANAV NR 2/22).
spots.enReason: Low score, stronger wind (8 kt) and a maritime rescue plan warning (ANAV NR 2/22).

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas menores e vento muito leve, mas há vários avisos de interação com animais marinhos (ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26, 2235/26).
spots.enReason: Smaller waves and very light wind, but multiple marine animal interaction warnings (ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26, 2235/26).
